benchmarks.label: Street coffee / iced milk coffee
benchmarks.traveler_context: Cà phê sữa đá, black coffee, or simple café drink.
benchmarks.notes: Specialty cafés and tourist streets can cost more.

benchmarks.label: Bánh mì
benchmarks.traveler_context: Street stall or casual shop sandwich.
benchmarks.notes: Famous shops and tourist zones price higher.

benchmarks.label: Phở or noodle soup
benchmarks.traveler_context: Local breakfast/lunch bowl in a casual shop.
benchmarks.notes: Hotel restaurants and destination-famous shops can exceed this.

benchmarks.label: Local beer
benchmarks.traveler_context: Bia hơi, bottled local beer, or casual bar beer.
benchmarks.notes: Rooftop bars and beach clubs are much higher.

benchmarks.label: Short GrabBike ride
benchmarks.traveler_context: Short urban motorbike ride in a major city before surge.
benchmarks.notes: Rain, airport zones, rush hour, and surge pricing change fares.

benchmarks.label: Short taxi ride
benchmarks.traveler_context: Short city taxi ride by car.
benchmarks.notes: Use reputable companies or apps; confirm meter or app fare.

benchmarks.label: Hostel bed
benchmarks.traveler_context: Dorm bed in a tourist city.
benchmarks.notes: Beach/island and festival periods push prices up.

benchmarks.label: Boutique hotel room
benchmarks.traveler_context: Private room in a well-reviewed boutique hotel or homestay.
benchmarks.notes: Hanoi/HCMC central districts, Hoi An, and Phu Quoc vary sharply by season.

benchmarks.label: Tourist SIM/eSIM data package
benchmarks.traveler_context: Short-stay data package from an airport kiosk, city shop, or eSIM provider.
benchmarks.notes: Airport convenience costs more; verify data allowance and hotspot rules.
